When the query seurat is too large, split it into subsets.
Need maually create configs. (You can skip building reference)
```{R}
library(Seurat)
```
```{R}
sobj <- readRDS('/home/yulicai/spatial/BPcell_xenium/mergrd_xenium_joinlayer_sct.rds')
```
```{R}
n <- 5
set.seed(111)
sobj$random_group <- ave(
    seq_len(ncol(sobj)),
    sobj$sample_ID,     # subsets will have same proportion of samples
    FUN = function(x) sample(rep(seq_len(n), length.out = length(x)))
)
```
```{R}
seurat_list <- SplitObject(sobj, split.by = 'random_group')
```
```{R}
for (i in seq_along(seurat_list)){
    saveRDS(seurat_list[[i]], file = paste0('/path/to/save/sobj_sub_',i,'.rds'))
}
```
